_note: Cases retired from the matrix whose measured rows still publish (user decision 2026-10-24: the 2026-10-22 round keeps its LTX-2 and LTX-2.3 rows). page_export.build_sections adds an entry here only for a case id the run measured and the current config no longer has, so the row keeps its label, shape and the other frameworks' classifications instead of vanishing from the page; the runner and the command-drift check never read this file. Each entry is the case as the build emitted it at its last commit in the matrix (retired.last_built_at), reduced to what the page shows.

cases.label: LTX-2 two-stage T2V
cases.prompt: A cat and a dog baking a cake together in a kitchen.

report_framework_reasons.lightx2v: LightX2V cannot run the official LTX-2 two-stage workload (dev model for stage 1, distilled LoRA for the 3-step stage-2 refine): its runner loads one transformer and merges lora_configs into it at load, and the use_upsampler path reuses that same transformer for stage 2 (lightx2v/models/runners/ltx2/ltx2_runner.py at 19c19614). The profile it had did not enable the upsampler at all, so every earlier LightX2V row ran ONE stage at the full 768x512 for 40 steps -- a heavier workload than the other rows, never comparable. Audited 2026-10-22.
report_framework_reasons.fastvideo: FastVideo main (2b164405c3d1, 2026-10-07) registers LTX-2, but this harness integrates FastVideo for MiniMax-H3 only (2026-10-08); no command validated.

cases.label: LTX-2.3 two-stage T2V
cases.prompt: A cat and a dog baking a cake together in a kitchen.

report_framework_reasons.lightx2v: LightX2V cannot run the official LTX-2.3 two-stage workload: one transformer serves both stages with any LoRA merged at load (ltx2_runner.py at 19c19614), and the profile it had never enabled the upsampler, so every earlier row was one stage at the full 768x512 -- heavier than sglang's two-stage, never comparable. Audited 2026-10-22.
report_framework_reasons.trtllm-visual: TensorRT-LLM 1.4.0rc1 has no LTX-2.3: LTX2Pipeline lists only Lightricks/LTX-2 (19B), and '2.3' appears in no hf_id, config, test or supported-models table (checked 2026-10-22).
report_framework_reasons.comfyui: ComfyUI loads LTX-2.3, but no official workflow reproduces this case: sglang runs LTX-2.3's multimodal guidance in stage 1 (video CFG 3 + STG 1.0 on block 28 + modality 3, audio CFG 7 + STG + modality -- up to four DiT passes per step, LTX23SamplingParams), while ComfyUI's LTX-2.3 T2V template (and the LTX-2.5 one) is the distilled-LoRA fast path at cfg 1. A graph built from LTXVSpatioTemporalGuidance / LTXVModalityGuidance / LTXVDualCFGGuider could match it but has no upstream reference and is not validated.
report_framework_reasons.fastvideo: FastVideo main (2b164405c3d1, 2026-10-07) registers LTX-2.3, but this harness integrates FastVideo for MiniMax-H3 only (2026-10-08); no command validated.
